patch_description:
This program is a crossover between two prior ansatz designs. It keeps the fixed
training, data, and measurement infrastructure while evolving the ANSATZ_SPEC
to combine the best elements:

- Adds deterministic CZ entangling on the outer ring (fixed, no extra params)
  to provide stable entanglement patterns early in the block (helpful for
  training stability and faster feature mixing).
- Retains parameterized CRZ edges (shared 'crz_ring' and 'crz_center') so the
  model can tune entangling phases where needed.
- Keeps motif-discovery three-qubit gates: ZZZ motifs split by geometric
  category, and CCRZ motifs for center/diagonal interactions. These encourage
  the ansatz to directly represent winning-line correlations.
- Uses symmetry-grouped single-qubit rotations (shared parameter strings) to
  be parameter-efficient while preserving geometric inductive bias.
- Combines post-rotations: RZ and RX use the same shared param keys
  (rz_corner/rz_edge/rz_center) to reduce unique parameter count while
  providing both rotation axes for expressivity.

Parameter sharing is deliberate to maintain compact parameterization (same
number of unique params per block as the seed variants), improve parameter
efficiency, and retain high expressivity through mixed fixed and parametric
entanglement.

All other code (data handling, feature map, training loop, and measurement
mapping) is unchanged; only the EVOLVE-BLOCK (ANSATZ_SPEC) is modified.
